description_en: Queries the information about all private access policies under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号下所有内网访问策略的信息
name: ListPrivateAccessPolices

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page that is returned during paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page that is set during paginated queries. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the private access policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase English letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the private access policy. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The action of the private access policy. Valid values:
Block: Block.
Allow: Allow
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许
parameters.name: policy_action

parameters.help_en: The collection of private access policy IDs. You can specify up to 100 private access policy IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问策略ID
parameters.name: policy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group. Sources of the value:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): Queries user groups by batch.
[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~): Creates a user group
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组。
[CreateUserGroup](~~CreateUserGroup~~)：创建用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the private access application. The application ID cannot be used together with the private access tag ID for filtering. Sources of the value:
[ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): Queries private access applications by batch.
[CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): Creates a private access application
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问应用ID。无法和内网访问标签ID同时过滤。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~)：批量查询内网访问应用。
[CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~)：创建内网访问应用
parameters.name: application_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the private access tag. The tag ID cannot be used together with the application ID for filtering. Sources of the value:
[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~): Queries private access tags by batch.
[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~): Creates a private access tag
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问标签ID。无法和应用ID同时过滤。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessTags](~~ListPrivateAccessTags~~)：批量查询内网访问标签。
[CreatePrivateAccessTag](~~CreatePrivateAccessTag~~)：创建内网访问标签
parameters.name: tag_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the private access application
parameters.name: application_name

Polices.description_en: The list of private access policies

ApplicationIds.description_en: The collection of application IDs of the private access policy. This field has a value when the application type is Application
ApplicationIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。当应用类型为Application时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The application ID of the private access policy

ApplicationType.description_en:
The application type of the private access policy. Valid values:
Application: Application.
Tag: Tag
ApplicationType.description_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
Application：应用。
Tag：标签

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the private access policy
CreateTime.description_zh: 内网访问策略创建时间

CustomUserAttributes.description_en: The collection of custom user group attributes. Multiple custom user group attributes have an OR relationship and take effect by union
CustomUserAttributes.description_zh: 自定义用户组属性集合。多个自定义用户组属性之间是或的关系，按照合集生效

IdpId.description_en: The identity provider ID of the user group. This value exists when the custom user group type is department
IdpId.description_zh: 用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，存在该值

Relation.description_en:
The relation of the user group. Valid values:
Equal: Equal.
Unequal: Not equal
Relation.description_zh:
用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于

UserGroupType.description_en:
The type of the user group. Valid values:
username: Username.
department: Department.
email: Email.
telephone: Mobile phone
UserGroupType.description_zh:
用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机

Value.description_en:
The value of the user group attribute.
When the user group type is username, this indicates the value of the username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length and supports Chinese characters and uppercase and lowercase English letters. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
When the user group type is department, this indicates the value of the department. For example: OU=Department1,OU=SASE DingTalk.
When the user group type is email, this indicates the value of the email. For example: username@example.com.
When the user group type is telephone, this indicates the value of the mobile phone. For example: 13900001234
Value.description_zh:
用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234

Description.description_en: The description of the private access policy
Description.example: 这是一条内网访问策略

DeviceAttributeAction.description_en:
The action to take when the security baseline is not met. Valid values:
Block: Block.
Observe: Observe
DeviceAttributeAction.description_zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：
Block：拦截。
Observe：观察

DeviceAttributeId.description_en: The ID of the security baseline policy

Name.description_en: The name of the private access policy

PolicyAction.description_en:
The action of the private access policy. Valid values:
Block: Block.
Allow: Allow
PolicyAction.description_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the private access policy

Priority.description_en: The priority of the private access policy. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高

Status.description_en:
The status of the private access policy. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
内网访问策略状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

TagIds.description_en: The collection of tag IDs of the private access policy. This field has a value when the application type is Tag
TagIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略的标签ID集合。当应用类型为Tag时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The tag ID of the private access policy

TriggerTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the trigger template

TrustedProcessGroupIds.description_en: The list of trusted process group IDs

items.description_en: The ID of the trusted process group

TrustedProcessStatus.description_en:
The status of the trusted process switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
TrustedProcessStatus.description_zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

TrustedSoftwareIds.description_en: The list of trusted software IDs

items.description_en: The ID of the trusted software

UserGroupIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs for the private access policy. This field has a value when the user group type is Normal
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 内网访问策略，用户组ID集合。当用户组类型为Normal时，该字段有值

items.description_en: The ID of the user group whose type is Normal for the private access policy
items.description_zh: 内网访问策略，用户组类型为Normal的用户组ID

UserGroupMode.description_en:
The user group type of the private access policy. Valid values:
Normal: Normal user group.
Custom: Custom user group
UserGroupMode.description_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组

ValidFrom.description_en: The effective start time of the zero trust policy, in second-level Unix timestamp
ValidFrom.description_zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳

ValidTimeStatus.description_en:
The status of the effective time switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
ValidTimeStatus.description_zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

ValidUntil.description_en: The effective end time of the zero trust policy, in second-level Unix timestamp
ValidUntil.description_zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of private access policies
